definitions: An expression indicating that things have been progressing well up to the present moment.
Used to express satisfaction with how something is proceeding, with an implicit understanding that challenges may still arise.
examples: We've completed the first two phases of the project, so far, so good!
The new software installation is going smoothly; so far, so good!
I've been on this diet for a week, and I haven't cheated once. So far, so good!
